name: Yuusha-kun
source:
The hope of humanity sent forth to vanquish the Demon King... Or so it was, until he was defeated by the Demon King and subjected to various humiliations.

He devoted himself to training from the moment he became aware of his surroundings, remaining a virgin. His knowledge of sex is also rather lacking in many ways.
